title: Fix customer ID mismatch between Keycloak JWT and CustomerDomain

notes: Added KeycloakId property with XML doc explaining its role as the JWT sub claim.
Added KeycloakId = keycloakId to the integration event published after registration.

description: Add optional CustomerId param to CreateCustomer command
notes: Added optional Guid? CustomerId = null as the last parameter. Existing callers (tests, controller mapper) are unaffected since it's optional.
Handler now uses request.CustomerId when provided, falling back to Guid.CreateVersion7() for callers that don't supply one (API endpoint, tests).

description: Pass Keycloak UUID as CustomerId in UserRegisteredConsumer
notes: Consumer now parses KeycloakId as a Guid and passes it as CustomerId, so the customer record is stored under the Keycloak UUID (same as JWT sub).

description: Fix KeycloakAuthService.SignInAsync to use JWT sub for user.
notes: SignInAsync now calls ParseJwtToUserDto(result.AccessToken) to derive user.Id from the JWT sub claim (Keycloak UUID), exactly the same as the page-refresh path. Falls back to result.UserId only if JWT parsing fails.
